summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by editing files only; no tests were run, per instructions, and nothing was committed. CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 marked Unreleased, Added subheading with the two entries, existing entry kept. tests/test_align.py: VerticalCenter import, repr, rendering, measurement, and tall-content tests. tests/test_tree.py: Measurement import and a test expecting Measurement(11, 19). Test results: not run. Out-of-scope items untouched.
